name: @dawlabs/jira-cli-mcp
stderr:
Usage: jira [options] [command]

Jira Cloud + Confluence Cloud CLI & MCP server — full REST v3 surface, JQL, XML
export, identity map, Confluence spaces/pages/sync. Pure Jira + Confluence REST
API only.

Options:
  -v, --version           print version
  --account <name>        use this credential profile from ~/.jcm/accounts.json
                          — must be allowed by the project policy (env:
                          JCM_ACCOUNT)
  --json                  print the structured result as JSON to stdout
  -q, --quiet             suppress progress output on stderr
  --verbose               show rate-limit waits, retries, and request URLs on
                          stderr
  --cwd <dir>             run as if started in this directory (affects
                          workspace→project detection)
  --max-wait <ms>         max ms to wait for rate-limit budget before failing (0
                          = never wait)
  --no-cache              bypass the local read-through cache for this run
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  config                  manage the centralized ~/.jcm configuration
  doctor [options]        check Node version, ~/.jcm validity, credentials,
                          project files, and local state
  auth                    connection and rate-limit status
  myself                  show the authenticated Jira user
  search [options] <jql>  search issues with JQL (e.g. jira search 'project =
                          DEMO AND status != Done ORDER BY updated DESC')
  issue                   issue operations (get, create, update, move, comment,
                          …)
  user                    user lookup
  project                 projects
  filter                  saved JQL filters
  meta                    discover fields, types, statuses, priorities
  status                  workflow statuses
  type                    issue types
  priority                priorities
  board                   scrum/kanban boards
  sprint                  sprints
  epic                    epics
  backlog [options]       backlog issues of a board
  identity                identity map: jira username ↔ email ↔ github ↔
                          nickname ↔ …
  export                  export issues
  cache                   local one-way cache (hot entries + historical
                          snapshots)
  mcp                     Model Context Protocol server
  confluence              Confluence Cloud spaces, pages, and markdown sync
                          (same ~/.jcm account; policy-guarded writes)
  mine [options]          my open tickets (add --or <name> for "me or <name>")
  done [options]          completed by me (or --or <name>) within a window
  recent [options]        updated by/touched by me within a window
  blocked [options]       open tickets labelled Blocked* (scans open issues,
                          filters locally)
  watching [options]      open tickets I watch
  help [command]          display help for command

Examples:
  jira config init --baseUrl https://yourteam.atlassian.net --email you@team.com --apiToken env:JIRA_API_TOKEN
  jira auth test                        # verify credentials + connectivity
  jira search 'assignee = currentUser() AND updated >= -7d ORDER BY updated DESC'
  jira issue get DEMO-15 --comments
  jira export xml DEMO-15,DEMO-84 --out tickets.xml
  jira mcp serve --transport stdio      # MCP server for LLM agents

Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 usage · 2 Jira API (incl. rate limit) · 3 network · 4 config · 5 MCP
Docs: https://github.com/sikancil/jira-cli-mcp (see docs/)
